rows.grounds: compound of kula, conduct, and order; accusative object requested
vocative epithet of the addressed deva

items.question: What order of Kula conduct should the compassionate deva explain?
premises: The verse requests the order of Kula conduct.
Compassion is invoked as an address.
items.inference: The speaker seeks guidance on Kula conduct.
uncertainties: Whether deva refers specifically to Śiva in this context.
Whether me is dative or genitive in the fused address.
items.plain_english: O deva, ocean of compassion, tell me the order of Kula conduct.
